Initial observation: The existing `--coral` variable in the CSS corresponds to Minh Ngo's orange.  Now, proposing to introduce custom styling for a Marvel/Avengers theme, defining new CSS variables for crimson, gold, cyan, and a glowing cyan effect, with the intention of applying the styling to an Arc Reactor pulse on a navigation dot.


Defined CSS for the Arc Reactor pulse animation and applied a linear gradient background with gold text shadow to the profile modal header, incorporating Stark Industries/Avengers branding. Determined the need for a script to automate the replacement of existing content in `index.html` with specific data, including title, meta description, navigation brand, and lid text, ensuring accurate data substitution from the provided source.


Incorporated the 'TOP SECRET // LEVEL 7' and 'AVENGERS INITIATIVE // TECH LAB' text elements into the SVG decorative element. Added Avengers "A" and Arc Reactor sticker graphics to the SVG.

Populated the "Inside Box Objects Labels" with descriptive titles for the camera, phone, folder, swatch, idcard, and brand. Defined the profile modal content, including header, photo, name, role, education, and lists of skills and technologies, along with social media links.


Added Mudasir's contact information (email, social links, and scheduling link) to the profile content. Incorporated Mudasir's biography, work experience (freelance and WordPress specialist roles), and education details within the profile. Added project descriptions with corresponding image assets for Little Calm Company, HLXperts Portal, and Nexoraverse Streaming Platform. Updated the bottom links object with Mudasir's live links.
